records.text: Blake Wynn said in a November 2025 Bring the Juice interview that he and Enclave and Key did a lot of political work, that he regularly spoke with Kash Patel and was good friends with Charlie Kirk, and that he sat next to Trump at Mar-a-Lago on election night 2024 alongside Elon Musk, Dana White, and Steve Witkoff, according to the article Owens read.
